SELECT
  cs.pending_case_id,
  fi.incident_type AS pending_type,
  fi.priority AS pending_priority
FROM conversation_state cs
LEFT JOIN forest_incidents fi ON fi.case_id = cs.pending_case_id
WHERE cs.user_phone = $1
  AND cs.updated_at > NOW() - make_interval(mins => $2::int)
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO conversation_state (
  user_phone,
  pending_case_id
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $("Preparar Registro").first().json.original.from }}',
  '{{ $("Preparar Registro").first().json.original.caseId }}'
)

ON CONFLICT (user_phone)
DO UPDATE SET
  pending_case_id='{{ $("Preparar Registro").first().json.original.caseId }}',
  updated_at=NOW();
